description.value: Bun Cha Ca Hoang Yen is a Vietnamese noodle-soup restaurant specializing in bún chả cá (fish cake vermicelli), phở, hủ tiếu, and a wide range of traditional appetizers, operating since at least 2012. The restaurant was a finalist for 'Best Vietnamese' in Vancouver in 2018 and announced a move to a larger 3,000 sq ft space with a patio and 150 seats. Touring cyclists would find a full Vietnamese menu with hearty, restorative noodle soups.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 50m; rack (4 spaces) at 53m; rack (3 spaces) at 75m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this restaurant at 4883 Kingsway, Burnaby, but the website consistently lists the address as 5155 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5P 3V1 — an 'upcoming location' page confirms the business announced a move to that address around Dec–Jan 2022. The website's 'Metrotown' location entry duplicates the same 5155 Victoria Dr address, suggesting the Burnaby/Metrotown location either never opened or has since closed. No bike amenities, washrooms, or takeout/delivery options are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Major address discrepancy: OSM shows 4883 Kingsway, Burnaby; website consistently shows 5155 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5P 3V1.
Website 'upcoming location' page announces a move to 5155 Victoria Dr (Grand Opening Dec–Jan 2022), suggesting the Kingsway/Burnaby location may be the old or never-opened site.
The website's 'Metrotown' location entry shows the same address as the 'East Vancouver' entry (5155 Victoria Dr), which may indicate the Metrotown location plans were abandoned.
OSM record likely needs to be updated or removed if this location is no longer active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM address (4883 Kingsway, Burnaby) does not match the website address (5155 Victoria Dr, Vancouver), and the business's own 'upcoming location' page indicates a move away from the Burnaby/Metrotown area circa 2022. The OSM node may represent a location that never opened or has since closed; the current active location appears to be in East Vancouver and should be verified before listing.
